from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import CartesianBinning, BinningCut
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nJets, get_nBTags

# Define jet multiplicity binning: 4, 5, >= 6 jets
jet_bins = BinningCut(
    name="nJets",
    cut_fn=get_nJets,
    bins=[
        (4, 4, "exactly_4j"),
        (5, 5, "exactly_5j"),
        (6, None, "at_least_6j")
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning: 2, >= 3 b-tags
btag_bins = BinningCut(
    name="nBTags",
    cut_fn=get_nBTags,
    bins=[
        (2, 2, "exactly_2b"),
        (3, None, "at_least_3b")
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
categories = CartesianBinning(
    binnings=[jet_bins, btag_bins]
)

# The categories object now contains all 6 combinations:
# (4j, 2b), (4j, >=3b), (5j, 2b), (5j, >=3b), (>=6j, 2b), (>=6j, >=3b)
